specs.Compatible Devices: Gaming Console, Laptop, Smartphone, Speaker, Television

features: 【HD Projection Screen】The movie projector offers a 40-130 inch projection screen with an optimal projection distance of 5.51 feet. Supports 4K 1080P, automatic horizontal keystone correction function provides you the best screen position.

HD Projection, Supports 4K Video Playback & Stereo Sound: Supports 4K video playback via USB drive for smooth viewing. High quality optical lens delivers clear images and is scratch resistant and easy to clean. Built-in stereo speakers provide clear sound for movies, TV shows and casual games, ideal for use as a telephone projector.

Dynamic starry sky mode and 180° rotating design: activate the dynamic starry sky mode with one-touch control on the remote control. With 9 animated starry sky scenes and a built-in sleep timer, the projector for bedroom displays dynamic star patterns on the ceiling to create a soothing sleeping atmosphere for children. The 180° rotating design allows you to easily adjust the angle for wall or ceiling projection.

Auto keystone, dual focus and big screen projection: supports automatic and manual focus for quick and precise image adjustment. Automatic vertical keystone correction delivers a perfectly aligned image in seconds. The short throw ratio of 0.9:1 allows large screen projection in a small space and supports 30-200 inch screen sizes (recommended 40-100 inches).

Ultra portable mini projector for indoor and outdoor use: weighs only 0.35 kg with a compact size of 3.73 × 3.73 × 15.7 cm. EASY TO CARRY IN A BACKPACK - Perfect for camping, travel, dorm room, bedroom, outdoor movie nights and small apartments.
description: 【180° Rotatable Mini Projector】The projector base includes a 180° rotating bracket that allows you to orient the projector in various directions, from wall to ceiling. You can view at any angle from 40 to 130 feet with a clear image on the screen.
